name: Krannert Building
changes_since_round1: Refined the source-model chair upholstery with separate eased seat pads and added soft, fine procedural fabric/wood/carpet variation; retained the established local asset frame.

Replaced the straight Parrish counter frontage with a curved oak desk form based on the 2026 Purdue Libraries refresh preview, and added a continuous winding study table with four public-computer stations and upholstered task chairs.
Added a compact glazed Drawing Room group room with a centered door, six conference seats, table supports, and an open approach aisle; its bounds remain inside the modeled carpet footprint.
Added a separate lounge setting, two window-side high tables and four stools with metal foot rings to represent the documented mixture of lounge, booth, high-top, and work seating.
Adjusted conference-table and high-top supports to meet the modeled floor; updated pull-back eye-level renders and separate per-floor plan views for layout/circulation inspection.

sources.use: Page 6 supports Drawing Room furnishing types and palette: glass-walled meeting rooms, blue/lime upholstery, patterned lounge seating, high-top tables/stools and acoustic materials. Page 4 supports Parrish Library book shelving, booth seating and study areas. Images are not measured floor plans.

Documents Parrish refresh and depicts planned desk/table/furniture changes, including a winding shared study table and computer work areas. The post describes renovations in progress; previews do not establish as-built coordinates, dimensions or completed finish conditions.

sources.provider: OfficeWorks, Purdue University’s Krannert School of Management Drawing Room
sources.use: Supports the Drawing Room's glass-walled group rooms and varied lounge/booth/high-top seating mix. It does not provide a dimensioned interior plan.

room_geometry.measurement_status: Model-derived only; room placement, dimensions, door clear opening and aisle are estimates, not survey or code/accessibility dimensions.

evidence_limits.interior_plan: No measured or current as-built floor plan was located. Room XY coordinates, partition location, furniture sizes/counts, support details and workstation placement are estimated.
evidence_limits.parrish_refresh: The 2026 Libraries post reports work in progress and includes previews; it does not verify final installed furnishings or exact layout.
evidence_limits.circulation: Eye-level and top-down renders show the modeled furniture organization and open approach path only. A 0.78 m model gap is not a code-compliance or accessibility determination.
evidence_limits.exterior_and_master: This source-only round did not edit or verify master placement, manifest, README, shared indexes, or other buildings; root/master ownership is unchanged.
evidence_limits.render_only: Camera, lights and temporary plan-render floor are created by audit scripts and are not saved into the asset.

independent_grade_status: Awaiting fresh independent review; no self-score assigned.
